metadata.agent_last_message:
I created a C++20 command-line simulator in [output/](/workspace/output) and confirmed it builds with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. A linear-motion smoke test produced the requested state and trace JSON.

**This is not a complete implementation of the specification.** In particular, canned cycles, cutter-compensated paths, and several trace and error cases remain unfinished. It should not be relied on to validate CNC programs yet.
